title: Derevi vs Nadu vs Rograkh/Silas vs Godo | CEDH Gameplay

players.note: confirmed from on-screen overlays via video frame sampling 2026-08-24 (Turn 01 frame shows all four nameplates and 40/39/40/40 life)

deck_fidelity.godo: archetype-substitute: the video's TCGplayer decklist link is dead (deck deleted); godo_archetype.txt is the same channel's June 2026 Godo build, ~22 months newer than this August 2024 video, so name repairs against it are weaker. In practice all 11 Godo-seat plays spoken in the transcript (Urza's Saga, Mountain, Mox Opal, Great Furnace, Grim Monolith, Manifold Key, Crystal Vein, Goblin Engineer, Defense Grid, Seething Song, Thunderclap) appear in the archetype list.

extraction.method: manual LLM read of auto-captions (data/transcripts/2iA_Jt0d6sM.txt), plus targeted video frame sampling (yt-dlp --download-sections + ffmpeg stills) for overlays, seat layout, turn counter, life totals, and the game-review card
caveats: 9.4-minute heavily edited short-form video, but the edit is a continuous narrated recap: one game, every turn narrated in order, so the line is unusually recoverable for its length.
Auto-captions only; card names garbled and repaired against the decklists; notable repairs flagged per play.
Mulligans and opening-hand decisions are fully edited out; nothing recoverable.
Life totals are read from sampled overlay frames at three checkpoints, not tracked continuously.
The overlay turn counter counts rounds (all four seats), not player-turns; win_turn_estimate below is the winner's own elapsed turns, which here coincides with round 5.

games.seat_order_confidence: high; narrated turn cycle Sasha -> Andy -> Brian -> Ryan is consistent all game and matches the overlay frames
games.win_turn_note: Andy's own 5th turn; the on-screen counter reads TURN 05 in sampled frames during both the Chord of Calling and the winning Snap loop
games.win_method: Chord of Calling X=3 finds Nadu, Winged Wisdom (a card in Derevi's 99, not Brian's commander); Nomads en-Kor triggers Nadu repeatedly for lands and gas; Eldritch Evolution (sac Thrasios) finds Emiel the Blessed; Emiel-flickers-Derevi with Gaea's Cradle untaps makes infinite mana and, via Nadu, puts all lands onto the battlefield and the rest of the library in hand; Blind Obedience plus an Eternal Witness / Snap recast loop extorts the table to death
